name: manual_9fa998
claim: For recovery publication, construct and verify the complete target tree before an atomic non-force ref update; then fetch the remote head and compare its full tree and restored-file hashes to the verified local commit.

decisions.reviewer: Codex AFRP Type C Practitioner Mode 2
decisions.notes: The R4 recovery publication requires a complete-tree, compare-and-swap, and post-publication verification gate; retaining this procedure prevents future partial browser or API publications.
